annotations.title: Helper: ask the human to decide

description: For a helper session that is not in the call: puts its own question on the Decision Board, shown with the sender 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>'. Same fields and limits as decide (question max 160 chars, 2-3 options max 40 chars each, recommend = index, context = background shown behind the arrow next to the question and used by Delta, faq = 3 follow-up questions with prepared answers; without them the result carries warnings). Change or delete only own questions (same credential and from), else 403. Returns id and number; the answer comes from helper_next, never from the main agent's next. card_type done = completion report instead of a question: title (whole sentence, max 160), summary (max 600), evidence [{label, url?}] (max 5, http(s) only), live (bool), ask (optional follow-up question); no question/options/recommend/context/faq (422). The server shows the single button Seen; it never counts as an open decision. Same sender and same title while unseen updates that card. When the person marks it, helper_next gets {type: decision, card_type: done, id, number, verdict: seen, title, text? (answer to ask), by, answered_by, answered_via, answered_by_label}.

label.description: What it proves, max 80 chars (e.g. 'All 412 tests green').
label.title: Label

url.description: Optional http(s) link (PR, CI run, live page).
url.title: Url

q.description: A likely follow-up question of the person, max 200 chars.
q.title: Q

ask.description: card_type done: optional follow-up question (one sentence ending with ?), answered in a text field next to Seen.
ask.title: Ask

card_type.description: decision (default) or done: a completion report ('work finished') with title, summary, evidence, live, ask instead of question/options; the person only marks it Seen, no decision.
card_type.title: Card Type

context.description: Background (max 1500 chars) the person opens with the arrow next to the question; Delta reads its first sentences aloud with the card and explains from it, so write it for the ear: an example, one key number, no lists. Only reader-relevant, one line per part: Was / Warum / Bei Ja / Bei Nein.
context.title: Context

credential.description: Helper credential `token` from helper_credential or POST /api/helper/credential.
credential.title: Credential

evidence.description: card_type done: up to 5 proofs [{label, url?}], url only http(s).
evidence.title: Evidence

faq.description: Up to 3 likely follow-up questions with prepared answers [{q, a}] (max 200 chars each), hidden, for the voicebot. Without context and 3 faq the result carries `warnings`.
faq.title: Faq

helper_name.description: Name of this helper session, 1-40 chars (shown on the call page as `from`).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

id.description: Id of an own open decision to change or delete.
id.title: Id

live.description: card_type done: true = it is live (marked on the card).
live.title: Live

no_question.description: Id of a question_check event from helper_next: confirms the line was no question to the person (pass it alone).
no_question.title: No Question

options.description: Optional: 2 to 3 answer options, max 40 characters each.
options.title: Options

question.description: The question, max 160 chars (required when creating).
question.title: Question

summary.description: card_type done: short report, max 600 chars.
summary.title: Summary

title.description: card_type done: what is finished, one whole sentence, max 160 chars, no bare numbers.
title.title: Title

ttl_s.description: Optional: seconds until this card is hidden from the board if it is still open (or answered). Omit it and the card stays until it is answered or your session ends; never set a default.
ttl_s.title: Ttl S
